correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md gives a complete a∈(0,1), H=1−a parameterization, and exact radial angular multiplicity integral. Substituting y=s(s+2a), z=t(t+2a), F(z)=Γ(√(a²+z)−a)/(2√(a²+z)) yields the Abel equation ∫_0^y F(z)/√(y−z) dz=π. Its double Abel transform gives ∫_0^Y F(z)dz=2√Y, hence F(Y)=Y^(−1/2) almost everywhere; uniqueness of the measure tail follows by its LEFT-continuity (not right-continuity as misstated in the source), and inversion gives Γ(t)=2(a+t)/√(t(t+2a)). Independent symbolic differentiation gave exactly zero residual for Γ′+2a²/[t(t+2a)]^(3/2) and for (2√(t(t+2a)))′−Γ. The endpoint atom equals Γ(H) and the width is 2√(1−a²), while all points of the closed hole have zero multiplicity because the a-radius contact occurs only in a null set of angles. A sigma-finite infinite total measure is legitimate since first width moment is finite. The erroneous word right-continuous is correctable to left-continuous without changing the proof or theorem, but remains a public-source defect.
